identification: Single mahogany carver (armchair), William IV / early Victorian bar-back style with scroll arms, turned tapering front legs, drop-in seat in cream and blue striped fabric. Possibly genuine c.1830-50 (plausible age wear) or a later copy.

entries.note: Pair of Victorian-style solid mahogany Admiralty carvers (a pair, different chair style); about A$130 each.
